name: Myogi Arafune Saku Kogen Quasi-National Park

aliases: 妙義荒船佐久高原国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Myogi and Arafune rocky peaks and the Saku highlands on the Gunma-Nagano border, a classic Japanese landscape and climbing ground.
notes: Managed by Gunma/Nagano. The Myogi shrine and rock-climbing routes are the core.
